title: ProjectTemplate
description: Enables a standardized library where a user can pick from a template and apply it to a project so that they can quickly get up and running.

id.description: The unique identifier for the project template

scope.description: The scope of this project when released, it can be ORGanization level, which means only one instance per org. or project scoped.

image.description: The image to use when deploying.

description.description: The description of this project template for a user to find and discover it.

type.description: The type of project template used to indicate how to access and what to use

port.description: The port exposed by this template when deployed

expose_port.description: When deployed this will claim an available public port. When active, during first deployment will claim a port that maps to the internal port.

protocol.description: Specify how we might route traffic to the instance. This is useful for domain routing such as {projectId}.compute.dev.klustr.io

resolver.description: Specify how we resolve in a load balancer to get access to the service. If mode is HTTP we can safely assume to use http. For example `use_backend postgres_bar if { req.ssl_sni -m beg bar. }` is used with sni routing.

endpoint_url.description: The URL template that is used that will drive how to access for example https://${projectId}.dev.klustr.io

documentation_url.description: The full documentation for this project template for users to follow along

o11y.description: Observability endpoints for this by default added, for example if mongoDB we can expose default metric endpoints.

url.description: The endpoint url with replaceable symbols

labels.description: Any custom labels to apply to this o11y for dimensions

required_features.description: The required features for this project template in order to function.

dns.description: Requires that DNS be configured and setup for this. Assumes {project}.dev.klustr.io

zone.description: The zone that this DNS will provision under.

name.description: The zone that this DNS will provision under.

credentials.description: Credentials are required for this project to leverage and connect. Can configure
credentials.title: TemplateCredentialsConfiguration

id.description: The unique ID of this credential stored alongside the project.

label.description: The label for a user to read and understand what this credential is for.

env_var_username.description: The environment variable name for username.

env_var_password.description: The environment variable name for username.

username.description: The default username for the credential

git.description: Requires that a git project be configured on this.
git.title: TemplateGitConfiguration

git_url.description: The git URL that this will clone from.

oauth_client.description: Requires that credentials are active for this project.
oauth_client.title: TemplateOauthConfiguration

app.description: Requires a user to setup their application.
app.title: TemplateAppConfiguration

home_page_url.description: The home page url of the app.

privacy_url.description: The privacy url for users to view.

scopes.description: The consent scopes that the credential is needed by this template.

services.description: The services that this project relies on for example Identity, Consent, etc

creation_date.description: The date this template was created.

manifest_filename.description: The name of the file used when provisioning and templating the docker compose. Must be loaded into resources in order to resolve.

default_machine_type.description: The default machine type for this instance

autoscale.description: This project type supports autoscaling features and given load will enable autoscaling isntances up when needed.

restrictions.title: ProjectTemplateRestrictions
restrictions.description: Any restrictions such as limiting the number of instances allowed to be provisioned. For example, an organization may only have 1 pushgateway or 1 IDP provider etc.

limit_one_per_org.description: Indicates that this template can only be issued to one organization.
